name: IndicGenBench
intro: IndicGenBench 是 ACL 2024 发布的印度语言生成评测集，在 29 种语言、13 种文字和 4 个语系上评估跨语言摘要、双向翻译和三条跨语言问答轨道。
build_method: 复用四个公开数据源，筛选英文样本与现有印度语言译文，并由专业译者补齐任务字段和低资源语言
task_type: 跨语言摘要, 双向机器翻译, 跨语言问答
eval_feature: 29种语言, 13种文字, 4个语系, 高/中/低资源分组
task_type_en: Cross-lingual summarization, bidirectional machine translation, cross-lingual QA
build_method_en: Reuse four public source datasets, select English samples and existing Indic translations, and commission professional translators for missing task fields and lower-resource languages
eval_feature_en: 29 languages, 13 scripts, 4 language families, high/medium/low-resource groups
intro_en: IndicGenBench is the ACL 2024 benchmark for generation in 29 Indic languages across 13 scripts and four language families. It evaluates cross-lingual summarization, translation in both directions, and three cross-lingual QA tracks.
scale_en: 5 evaluation tracks; CrossSum-IN 20.3k, FLORES-IN 58.2k, XQuAD-IN 16.6k, XorQA-IN 32k
metric_en: ChrF for summarization and translation; SQuAD Token-F1 for QA

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.16816v2, the ACL 2024 paper, and official Git revision c96a10d90ed9b38cc2108cac6f515a1b8bfdc230. IndicGenBench covers 29 Indic languages, 13 scripts, and four families. Four released components supply five paper tracks: CrossSum-IN, FLORES-IN in both directions, XQuAD-IN, XorQA-IN-XX, and XorQA-IN-EN; the two XorQA views share one source component. Construction starts from CrossSum, FLORES-200, XQuAD/SQuAD, and XOR-TyDi, reuses English samples and existing translations, and uses professional contractors for missing task fields. Paper split counts are CrossSum 100/100/500 train/dev/test per language; FLORES 997/1,012 dev/devtest per language; XQuAD 20 passages / 100 QA train, 20 / 100 dev, and 240 / 1,190 test. XorQA uses a two-stage Bengali/Telugu-to-English-to-Indic translation path with 100 train, 500 dev, and 539 source test items. The release preserves source-dependent licenses and a canary in every JSON file. Main evaluation is one-shot with zero/five-shot and fine-tuning analyses. ChrF scores summarization and both translation directions; SQuAD Token-F1 scores all three QA tracks, reported by resource group.
